gaps.quote: A forward, inverse, forward schedule of these invocations exchanges the two banks and returns every auxiliary wire to its starting value (cited).
gaps.note: The page does not say what the inverse invocation is or how this schedule corresponds to the three updates D<-D-H, H<-H+D, D<-H-D. Forward, inverse, forward in the same direction would just repeat one addition, so the roles of the banks must swap, which is unstated. It also sits oddly with the claim that the outer two updates cost linear time rather than being network invocations.
